devdoc.details: Owner manages the SLP whitelist and the keeper; the keeper can only pay whitelisted SLPs.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

params.distributions: List of (slp, amount); the same SLP may appear more than once

params.keeper_: Initial keeper; may be zero and set later via `setKeeper`
params.slps_: Initial SLP whitelist; may be empty

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.allowed: true to whitelist, false to remove

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

devdoc.title: SlpDistributor

PROSReceived(address,uint256).notice: Emitted when native PROS is received

SlpWhitelistUpdated(address,bool).notice: Emitted when an SLP is added to or removed from the whitelist

distribute((address,uint256)[]).notice: Send native PROS to whitelisted SLPs, keeper only

setSlps(address[],bool).notice: Add or remove SLP contracts from the whitelist, owner only

userdoc.notice: Relay between StPROS and SLP contracts. StPROS forwards native PROS produced by minting to this contract (set as StPROS `slp`), and the keeper later splits the balance across whitelisted SLP contracts.
